styles.description: Ori series: lush hand-painted 2D art, glowing bioluminescent flora, soft volumetric light rays, deep teal and indigo forest shadows with luminous cyan and warm gold accents, layered parallax depth, delicate organic silhouettes, ethereal and emotional mood
Hollow Knight: hand-drawn 2D ink style, monochrome pale and black palette with sparse glowing accents, thin clean outlines, gothic insect-like silhouettes, misty dark caverns, melancholic atmosphere
Stardew Valley: 16-bit pixel art, bright warm farm-life palette, soft rounded shapes, simple readable sprites, cozy top-down countryside
Hades: bold stylized 2D illustration, thick dark outlines, saturated crimson and gold palette, dramatic rim lighting, dynamic mythological character design
Celeste: crisp low-resolution pixel art, limited vivid palette with pink, teal and purple, clean readable shapes, dreamy mountain scenery
Don't Starve: quirky Tim Burton-like gothic cartoon style, scratchy ink outlines, muted earthy palette, spindly exaggerated proportions, paper-cutout look
Studio Ghibli: soft watercolor-like hand-painted backgrounds, warm natural light, lush green nature, gentle rounded character design, nostalgic serene mood
Breath of the Wild: soft cel-shaded watercolor look, airy pastel palette, clean simple outlines, bright natural lighting, expansive open landscapes
